# Pujo Pandal — Siliguri Durga Puja 2026 guide

> Pujo Pandal (https://durgapujapandal.site) is a free, independent guide to Durga Puja in Siliguri, West Bengal, India. It maps 83 community Durga Puja pandals across 28 Siliguri neighbourhoods for 2026, with a smart pandal-hopping route planner, the festival schedule and local guides.

Key facts:
- Durga Puja 2026 in Siliguri runs from Maha Shashti (Saturday, 17 October 2026) to Bijoya Dashami (Wednesday, 21 October 2026). Mahalaya is on Saturday, 10 October 2026.
- 83 pandals: 28 theme, 18 traditional, 19 heritage, 14 community and 4 eco-friendly pujas; 38 have parking nearby.
- Busiest evenings: Ashtami and Navami, especially around Hill Cart Road, Sevoke Road and Venus More from 7 PM to midnight.
- Contact: pujopandal@gmail.com · Collegepara, Siliguri, West Bengal 734005.

## Core pages
- [Siliguri Durga Puja 2026 guide](https://durgapujapandal.site/): overview, countdown, featured pandals, zones and FAQs
- [All Siliguri pandals 2026](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-pandals): full list with themes, scores, parking and areas
- [Siliguri Durga Puja pandal map](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-map): interactive map of every pandal with GPS pins
- [Siliguri Puja routes](https://durgapujapandal.site/siliguri-puja-routes): route planner and curated walking, bike and car circuits
- [Durga Puja 2026 schedule](https://durgapujapandal.site/puja-schedule): dates and rituals from Mahalaya to Bijoya Dashami
- [Mahalaya 2026](https://durgapujapandal.site/mahalaya): date, 4 AM broadcast and tarpan in Siliguri
- [Pandals by area](https://durgapujapandal.site/areas): all 28 neighbourhoods

## Guides
- [Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026: Every Siliguri Pandal on One Map](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-pandal-map-2026): All 83 Siliguri pandals on one map — GPS pins, zones, parking notes, top-rated pujas and how to plan your evenings around them.
- [Siliguri Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026: Zone-Wise Pandal List](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/siliguri-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-zone-wise): Siliguri’s pandals split into five zones. Here is every zone with its top pandals, a map and how to cover it in one evening.
- [Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026: Best Walking Clusters in Siliguri](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-walking-routes): Three walkable pandal clusters where dozens of pujas sit within a short stroll — with maps, loop order and walking tips.
- [Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026 by Bike or Car: Pandals with Parking](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-bike-car-parking): 38 pandals list parking this year. Here is where you can drive, where you must walk in, and how to plan by bike or car.
- [How to Use the Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026 on Your Phone](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/how-to-use-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026): A step-by-step phone guide — search, filter, directions, saving pandals, building a route and staying online in crowds.
- [Best Theme Pandals on the Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026 (Siliguri)](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/best-theme-pandals-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026): The highest-rated theme pandals of 2026 — what each one is about, where it is on the map and when to go.
- [Traditional & Heritage Pujas on the Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/traditional-heritage-pujas-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026): Where to find ekchala pratima, daaker saaj and classic rituals in Siliguri — and when to time your visit.
- [Durga Puja 2026 Dates & Pandal Map: Day-Wise Plan for Siliguri](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-2026-dates-pandal-map-day-wise-plan): Mahalaya to Dashami: every 2026 date and which part of the pandal map to explore on each day.
- [Family-Friendly Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026: Easy Pandals in Siliguri](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/family-friendly-durga-puja-pandal-map-2026): Pandals with parking and short visits, plus practical tips for going out with children and elders.
- [Durga Puja Pandal Map 2026 Near NJP & Siliguri Junction Stations](https://durgapujapandal.site/blog/durga-puja-pandal-map-2026-near-njp-siliguri-junction): Pandals within easy reach of NJP and Siliguri Junction — perfect for a stopover or your first evening in town.
